summary: Frontend-only visual/DOM verification of the redesigned team.html org-chart network layout (Playwright, live preview URL). Verified all 4 department groups (Management 4, Construction & Engineering 3, Architecture & Design 3, Finance & Legal 4) at 1920/1024/768/761/390px. All 14 person nodes render as pure typographic text nodes (dot + serif name + uppercase sans role) with trunk+spine+drop connector lines; zero card/monogram/tile remnants (.tm-grid/.tm-card/.tm-tile/.tm-monogram/.tm-name/.tm-role/.tm-mail all return 0 elements; node background = transparent, border-width = 0). Department indices are now sequential 01 Management / 02 Construction & Engineering / 03 Architecture & Design / 04 Finance & Legal. Hover verified (dot scale(1.6), drop-line and name both tint to rgb(154,130,83) = #9a8253). Mobile 390px correctly collapses to a single continuous vertical hairline timeline (.tm-network::after, 1px, rgba(27,26,23,.28)) with trunk/spine display:none, 16px horizontal stubs, dots on the line and left-aligned name/role to the right — verified for ALL 4 groups (the groups the main agent could not self-verify). Zero horizontal overflow at every breakpoint. Zero console errors / pageerrors. Shared chrome (utility bar, header, side menu open/close with PARTNERS link, Get In Touch CTA, footer) all functional — no regressions.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal spine stops ~9-11px short of the LAST node's drop-line, leaving a visible detached gap so the final person in every department appears disconnected from the network. Cause: `right: calc(50% / var(--count))` computes the half-column offset from the FULL container width and ignores the 28px (20px <=1100px) column gaps. Measured: 4-col groups spine end x=1331 vs last dot cx=1342 (delta -11); 3-col groups spine end x=1290 vs last dot cx=1299 (delta -9). Suggested fix: right: calc((100% - (var(--count) - 1) * var(--tm-gap)) / var(--count) / 2 + ... ) using a --tm-gap variable, or drop the absolute spans and draw the spine with a border on the node row so it is gap-aware.

issues: At the tightest 4-col state the column is only ~152-154px, so long names wrap to 2 lines ('Prof. Dr. Yalcin Sahin', 'CHAIRMAN OF THE BOARD') which pushes that node's role line ~24px below its siblings, breaking the horizontal baseline alignment of the org-chart row. No text overlap and no overflow, but the row reads visually ragged. Consider dropping to 2 columns (or raising the timeline-collapse breakpoint above 760px) for --count:4 groups.

Drop-line color rgba(27,26,23,.16) on the #efeeec background is extremely faint (~1px at very low contrast); the connector graphic is barely perceptible on lower-brightness displays. Consider .20-.24 alpha for the drop lines.

action_items: Fix .tm-network-spine right offset so the spine actually meets the last node's drop-line (gap-aware calc) — currently a visible break in all 4 departments on desktop/tablet.
Optional polish: at 761-768px, 4-person departments squeeze names into 2 lines and misalign role baselines; consider 2-col or earlier timeline collapse.
Optional polish: increase drop-line alpha (.16 -> ~.22) for perceptibility.
critical_code_review_comments: .tm-network-spine uses percentage `right: calc(50% / var(--count))` which is not gap-aware; grid gap (28px/20px) makes the computed endpoint fall short of the last column center. Derive the offset from a shared --tm-gap custom property instead of a bare percentage.

The trunk starts at the network's left edge (x=465) while the first node's drop-line sits at the first column center (x=578), so the first ~113px of the spine is a purely decorative lead-in. Intentional-looking but worth confirming against the design intent.
team.css correctly hides .tm-network-trunk/.tm-network-spine on mobile and swaps to .tm-network::after; no orphan/dead rules from the old card layout remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: team.html network/org-chart redesign is functionally complete and verified across 1920/1024/768/761/390px: all data-testids (team-page-title, team-group-*, team-card-*-N for management 1-4, construction-and-engineering 1-3, architecture-and-design 1-3, finance-and-legal 1-4) present, visible and correctly mapped to names/roles; sequential 01-04 indices confirmed; hover accent confirmed; mobile timeline collapse confirmed for all 4 groups; zero overflow; zero console errors. Only open item is the cosmetic .tm-network-spine end-gap (~9-11px short of the last drop-line). partners.html untouched and shared chrome (incl. PARTNERS side-menu link) still works — no need to retest.
rca_of_the_issue: Spine gap RCA: `.tm-network-spine { right: calc(50% / var(--count)) }` assumes columns are exactly width/count wide. With `gap: 0 28px`, each column is (W - (count-1)*28)/count, so the last column's center is 28*(count-1)/2/count px further right than the percentage-derived endpoint — producing a 9px (3-col) to 11px (4-col) gap between the spine's right end and the last node's vertical drop-line at 1920px. Reproduce: open /team.html at 1920px, inspect any .tm-group, compare getBoundingClientRect() of .tm-network-spine right edge vs the last .tm-node-dot center.
